readerNotes.line: Traced from the heavy ticked line: enters at the top near Geilenkirchen, runs east along about 51.0N, down the Roer past Dueren and Monschau, west along the north shoulder of the bulge (Stavelot area), around the western tip near St Hubert, back east along the south shoulder past Bastogne to the Our and Sauer, then south east along the Moselle and Saar, leaving the east edge near 6.84E 49.23N. Small gaps in the line where grid labels and symbols cross it were bridged. Points east of 6.7E use one grid line for scale, so they may be off by about 0.01.
